name: Scythe Mod
description: Adds endgame scythes for PvP and survival: the Bloody Scythe with bleeding and Blood Harvest, the Toxic Scythe with armor-melting poison abilities, and the Withering Scythe as an empty legacy item. Includes custom abilities, HUD timers, advancements, recipes, Bloody Essence drops, and English/Russian localization.
